definitions: To destroy or greatly damage one's position in a game, in one's work or career, in one's financial or social position, etc.
A feature of a system whereby it destroys itself.

blocks.text: Self-destruction is a mechanism that can cause an object to destroy itself or render itself inoperable in certain circumstances.

images.alt: A Russian anti-personnel land mine POM-3 (Russian: Противопехотная Осколочная Мина, lit. 'Infantry shrapnel mine') with a self-deactivation mechanism that disables the mine upon expiration of battery charge.
